about: A self-hosted password manager for teams.

prs.title: Passwords ending in a backslash import correctly
prs.broken: Importing from KeePassXC, LastPass or 1Password garbled any entry whose value ended in a backslash. The saved password was wrong and the notes were lost, while the import said it worked.
prs.changed: The import now reads these files the standard way these apps write them, as TeamPass's general CSV import already did.
prs.matters: People moving to TeamPass get the passwords they actually had.

prs.title: CSV export keeps multi-line notes whole
prs.broken: Exporting to CSV broke on any item whose description had a line break. Reading the file back, that item lost its password and login, and later items were swallowed into it.
prs.changed: The export now writes each full record, line breaks included, and quotes values the standard way.
prs.matters: The export works as a real backup or a way to move to another password manager.

prs.title: Bitwarden imports keep custom fields
prs.broken: Importing a Bitwarden export dropped every custom field, such as PINs, security answers and API keys, with no warning.
prs.changed: Custom fields are now added to the item's notes as name and value lines.
prs.matters: Moving from Bitwarden no longer loses secrets.
